            前端大屏适配方案：rem、vw/vh、scale 到底选哪个？

                    阅读5分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><p>上周帮朋友救火一个数据大屏项目，甲方临时说要从 1920×1080 的投影换成 3840×1080 的超宽拼接屏。朋友用的是 <code>transform: scale</code> 方案，结果两边各留了一大片黑边，甲方当场黑脸。</p>
<p>这事儿让我决定把大屏适配这个"老生常谈但总有人踩坑"的话题彻底讲清楚。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">先说结论</h2>



































<table><thead><tr><th>方案</th><th>一句话总结</th><th>适合场景</th><th>不适合场景</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>scale</strong></td><td>整体等比缩放，简单粗暴</td><td>比例固定的展示型大屏</td><td>超宽屏/非标比例/有交互</td></tr><tr><td><strong>vw/vh</strong></td><td>视口单位，真正的流式适配</td><td>需要铺满全屏的响应式大屏</td><td>ECharts 字体适配麻烦</td></tr><tr><td><strong>rem</strong></td><td>根字体驱动，移动端经典方案</td><td>内容丰富、组件化开发</td><td>配置繁琐，效果接近 scale</td></tr><tr><td><strong>混合方案</strong></td><td>rem 管布局 + vw 管字体 + JS 管图表</td><td>生产级项目</td><td>小 demo 用不着</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>我的推荐：</strong> 如果是快速交付、比例固定，用 scale；如果是正经项目，用混合方案。别用纯 rem，性价比太低。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">方案一：scale（缩放大法）</h2>
<p>最简单的方案，核心思路是把整个页面当图片一样等比缩放。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">核心代码</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini">function setScale() {
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">designWidth</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1920</span>
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">designHeight</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1080</span>
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">wRatio</span> = window.innerWidth / designWidth
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">hRatio</span> = window.innerHeight / designHeight
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;// 取较小值，保证内容完整显示
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">ratio</span> = Math.min(wRatio, hRatio)
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">container</span> = document.getElementById(<span class="hljs-string">'app'</span>)
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">container.style.width</span> = designWidth + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">container.style.height</span> = designHeight + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">container.style.transform</span> = `scale(<span class="hljs-variable">${ratio}</span>)`
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">container.style.transformOrigin</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'left top'</span>
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;// 居中处理
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">marginLeft</span> = (window.innerWidth - designWidth * ratio) / <span class="hljs-number">2</span>
 &nbsp;const <span class="hljs-attr">marginTop</span> = (window.innerHeight - designHeight * ratio) / <span class="hljs-number">2</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">container.style.marginLeft</span> = marginLeft + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">container.style.marginTop</span> = marginTop + <span class="hljs-string">'px'</span>
}
​
window.addEventListener('resize', setScale)
setScale()
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">优点</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>开发成本极低</strong>：所有尺寸按设计稿 1:1 写 px，不用任何换算</li>
<li><strong>还原度高</strong>：等比缩放，设计稿怎么画就怎么写</li>
<li><strong>兼容性好</strong>：<code>transform</code> 兼容性没问题</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">踩坑记录</h3>
<p><strong>坑 1：字体模糊。</strong> 缩放比例不是整数时（比如 0.833），浏览器在亚像素渲染时会导致文字发虚。解决办法是给文字容器单独设置 <code>will-change: transform</code> 或者用 <code>-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased</code>，但只能缓解，不能根治。</p>
<p><strong>坑 2：鼠标坐标偏移。</strong> scale 缩放后，DOM 元素的实际位置和视觉位置不一致。如果大屏上有 tooltip、弹窗、拖拽等交互，鼠标位置会对不上。这个问题在 ECharts 的 tooltip 上尤为明显。</p>
<p><strong>坑 3：超宽屏留白。</strong> 就像我朋友遇到的情况，16:9 的设计稿放到 32:9 的拼接屏上，两边各空一大块。你可以选择拉伸（<code>Math.max</code>），但内容会变形。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">适用场景</h3>
<p>固定比例的纯展示大屏，没有复杂交互，交付时间紧。<strong>注意：这是个快餐方案，别当正餐吃。</strong></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-6">方案二：vw/vh（视口单位）</h2>
<p>vw/vh 是 CSS3 的视口单位，1vw = 视口宽度的 1%，1vh = 视口高度的 1%。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">核心实现</h3>
<p>用 SCSS 封装转换函数：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-less" lang="less"><span class="hljs-variable">@use</span> <span class="hljs-string">"sass:math"</span>;
​
$designWidth: 1920;
$designHeight: 1080;
​
<span class="hljs-variable">@function</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">vw</span>($px) {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-variable">@return</span> math.<span class="hljs-built_in">div</span>($px, $designWidth) * <span class="hljs-number">100vw</span>;
}
​
<span class="hljs-variable">@function</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">vh</span>($px) {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-variable">@return</span> math.<span class="hljs-built_in">div</span>($px, $designHeight) * <span class="hljs-number">100vh</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>使用：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-selector-class">.dashboard-card</span> {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">vw</span>(<span class="hljs-number">460</span>); &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;// <span class="hljs-number">460</span> / <span class="hljs-number">1920</span> * <span class="hljs-number">100vw</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">vh</span>(<span class="hljs-number">320</span>); &nbsp; &nbsp; // <span class="hljs-number">320</span> / <span class="hljs-number">1080</span> * <span class="hljs-number">100vh</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">padding</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">vh</span>(<span class="hljs-number">20</span>) <span class="hljs-built_in">vw</span>(<span class="hljs-number">24</span>);
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">font-size</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">vw</span>(<span class="hljs-number">14</span>); &nbsp; // 字体也用 vw
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">border-radius</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">vw</span>(<span class="hljs-number">8</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">优点</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>真正的流式适配</strong>：内容会铺满整个屏幕，不会留白</li>
<li><strong>无缩放副作用</strong>：没有 scale 带来的模糊和坐标偏移问题</li>
<li><strong>响应式</strong>：宽高独立计算，不同比例的屏幕都能适配</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">踩坑记录</h3>
<p><strong>坑 1：ECharts 不认 vw。</strong> ECharts 的 fontSize、padding 等配置只接受 px 数值。你需要一个 JS 转换函数：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">export function <span class="hljs-built_in">fitChartSize</span>(px, base = <span class="hljs-number">1920</span>) {
 &nbsp;const clientWidth = document<span class="hljs-selector-class">.documentElement</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.clientWidth</span>
 &nbsp;return <span class="hljs-built_in">Number</span>((px * clientWidth / base)<span class="hljs-selector-class">.toFixed</span>(<span class="hljs-number">3</span>))
}
​
<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用</span>
option = {
 &nbsp;title: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;textStyle: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;fontSize: <span class="hljs-built_in">fitChartSize</span>(<span class="hljs-number">18</span>)
 &nbsp;  }
  },
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">grid</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">left</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">fitChartSize</span>(<span class="hljs-number">60</span>),
 &nbsp; &nbsp;right: <span class="hljs-built_in">fitChartSize</span>(<span class="hljs-number">20</span>)
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>而且窗口 resize 后，ECharts 需要重新 setOption 才能更新字体大小，光调 <code>chart.resize()</code> 不够。</p>
<p><strong>坑 2：极端比例下内容挤压。</strong> 如果屏幕是 1080×1920（竖屏），用 vw 计算出的宽度值会变得很小，内容会严重挤压。需要加最小宽度兜底。</p>
<p><strong>坑 3：开发体验一般。</strong> 所有数值都得过一遍转换函数，写起来不如直接写 px 顺手。可以用 PostCSS 插件（如 <code>postcss-px-to-viewport</code>）自动转换来缓解。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">适用场景</h3>
<p>需要适配多种比例的全屏大屏，希望内容始终铺满，没有留白。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">方案三：rem（根字体缩放）</h2>
<p>rem 的原理是通过动态修改 <code>html</code> 的 <code>font-size</code> 来实现全局缩放。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">核心实现</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// flexible.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_WIDTH</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1920</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_HEIGHT</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1080</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_FONT_SIZE</span> = <span class="hljs-number">16</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateRootFontSize</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { clientWidth, clientHeight } = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">documentElement</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-comment">// 宽高比判断，取较小缩放比</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ratio = clientWidth / clientHeight &gt; <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_WIDTH</span> / <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_HEIGHT</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp;? clientHeight / <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_HEIGHT</span>
 &nbsp;  : clientWidth / <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_WIDTH</span>
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">documentElement</span>.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">fontSize</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${ratio * BASE_FONT_SIZE}</span>px`</span>
}
​
<span class="hljs-title function_">updateRootFontSize</span>()
<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, updateRootFontSize)
</code></pre>
<p>配合 <code>postcss-pxtorem</code> 自动将 px 转为 rem：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-java" lang="java"><span class="hljs-comment">// postcss.config.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">module</span>.<span class="hljs-keyword">exports</span> = {
 &nbsp;plugins: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-string">'postcss-pxtorem'</span>: {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;rootValue: <span class="hljs-number">16</span>,
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;propList: [<span class="hljs-string">'*'</span>],
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;minPixelValue: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>
 &nbsp;  }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">我的看法</h3>
<p>说实话，rem 方案在大屏场景下有点<strong>过度设计</strong>。它的本质是：动态 font-size + rem 单位 → 等比缩放。最终效果跟 scale 差不多——都是等比缩放，不同比例的屏幕依然会留白。</p>
<p>但它比 scale 多了一堆配置（PostCSS 插件、flexible 脚本、rootValue 计算），开发体验并没有提升。rem 在移动端是经典方案，但在大屏场景，我觉得不如 scale 简单或 vw/vh 灵活。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-14">方案四：混合方案（我的推荐）</h2>
<p>实际项目中，我一般用混合方案：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">布局容器 → vw/vh（铺满屏幕）
组件内部 → rem 或 px（保持组件独立性） &nbsp;
ECharts 等第三方库 → JS 动态计算 px
极端比例兜底 → CSS <span class="hljs-built_in">clamp</span>() + 最小宽度
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">架构设计</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-yaml" lang="yaml"><span class="hljs-string">┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">浏览器视口</span> <span class="hljs-string">(100vw</span> <span class="hljs-string">×</span> <span class="hljs-string">100vh)</span> &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">┌──────────┐</span>  <span class="hljs-string">┌──────────────────────┐</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">左侧栏</span> &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">主内容区</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-attr">w:</span> <span class="hljs-string">20vw</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">w:</span> <span class="hljs-string">80vw</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-attr">h:</span> <span class="hljs-string">100vh</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-attr">h:</span> <span class="hljs-string">100vh</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">内部组件</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">┌────────────────┐</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">用</span> <span class="hljs-string">rem</span> &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">ECharts</span> <span class="hljs-string">图表</span> &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">JS</span> <span class="hljs-string">计算</span> <span class="hljs-string">px</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">└────────────────┘</span>  <span class="hljs-string">│</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">│</span>  <span class="hljs-string">└──────────┘</span>  <span class="hljs-string">└──────────────────────┘</span> <span class="hljs-string">│</span>
<span class="hljs-string">└─────────────────────────────────────────┘</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-16">关键代码</h3>
<p><strong>1. 布局层用 vw/vh：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-selector-class">.layout-left</span> {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20vw</span>;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100vh</span>;
}
​
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.layout-main</span> {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">80vw</span>;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100vh</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>2. 组件内用 CSS clamp() 做弹性字体：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css"><span class="hljs-selector-class">.card-title</span> {
 &nbsp;// 最小 <span class="hljs-number">12px</span>，理想 <span class="hljs-number">1vw</span>，最大 <span class="hljs-number">24px</span>
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">font-size</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">clamp</span>(<span class="hljs-number">12px</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1vw</span>, <span class="hljs-number">24px</span>);
}
​
<span class="hljs-selector-class">.card-value</span> {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">font-size</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">clamp</span>(<span class="hljs-number">24px</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2.5vw</span>, <span class="hljs-number">56px</span>);
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">font-weight</span>: bold;
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>clamp()</code> 是个被低估的 CSS 函数，它让字体在合理范围内自适应，不会在超大屏上变成巨型字、也不会在小屏上小到看不清。</p>
<p><strong>3. ECharts 封装自适应 hook（Vue 3）：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// useChartResize.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> * <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> echarts <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'echarts'</span>
​
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">useChartResize</span>(<span class="hljs-params">chartRef: Ref&lt;HTMLElement | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt;</span>) {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">chart</span>: echarts.<span class="hljs-property">ECharts</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fitSize</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">px: number, base = <span class="hljs-number">1920</span></span>) =&gt; {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> width = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">documentElement</span>.<span class="hljs-property">clientWidth</span>
 &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">round</span>(px * width / base)
  }
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleResize</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (chart) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;chart.<span class="hljs-title function_">resize</span>()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-comment">// 重要：resize 后要重新设置包含字体大小的 option</span>
 &nbsp;  }
  }
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (chartRef.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;chart = echarts.<span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>(chartRef.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, handleResize)
 &nbsp;  }
  })
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-title function_">onUnmounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resize'</span>, handleResize)
 &nbsp; &nbsp;chart?.<span class="hljs-title function_">dispose</span>()
  })
 &nbsp;
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { chart, fitSize }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>4. 极端比例兜底：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-arduino" lang="arduino"><span class="hljs-meta">#app {</span>
 &nbsp;min-width: <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>px;
 &nbsp;min-height: <span class="hljs-number">600</span>px;
 &nbsp;overflow: <span class="hljs-keyword">auto</span>; &nbsp;<span class="hljs-comment">/* 实在太小就出滚动条 */</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-17">2026 年的新选择：CSS Container Queries</h2>
<p>这里补充一个很多大屏适配文章没提到的新玩意儿——<strong>容器查询（Container Queries）</strong> 。</p>
<p>传统的媒体查询（Media Queries）基于视口尺寸，而容器查询基于<strong>父容器尺寸</strong>。这意味着组件可以根据自己所在区域的大小来调整样式，而不是根据整个屏幕。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-less" lang="less"><span class="hljs-selector-class">.chart-wrapper</span> {
 &nbsp;container-type: <span class="hljs-attribute">inline-size;
 &nbsp;container-name</span>: chart;
}
​
<span class="hljs-variable">@container</span> chart (<span class="hljs-attribute">min-width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">600px</span>) {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-selector-class">.chart-title</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">font-size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">18px</span>; }
 &nbsp;.chart-legend { <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: flex; }
}
​
<span class="hljs-variable">@container</span> chart (<span class="hljs-attribute">max-width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">599px</span>) {
 &nbsp;<span class="hljs-selector-class">.chart-title</span> { <span class="hljs-attribute">font-size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">14px</span>; }
 &nbsp;.chart-legend { <span class="hljs-attribute">display</span>: none; }
}
</code></pre>
<p>截至 2026 年初，主流浏览器（Chrome 105+、Firefox 110+、Safari 16+）都已支持容器查询。在大屏项目中，特别是一个组件可能出现在不同大小区域的场景下，容器查询比媒体查询好用得多。</p>
<p>不过要注意，容器查询解决的是<strong>组件级响应式</strong>，不能替代全局的适配方案。它更适合作为混合方案中的一环。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-18">实战选型决策树</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">你的大屏需要适配多种比例吗？
├── 不需要（固定 16:9）
│ &nbsp; └── 有复杂交互吗？
│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; ├── 没有 → scale ✅ 快速搞定
│ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; └── 有 → vw/vh + JS 图表适配
└── 需要（多种屏幕）
 &nbsp;  └── 混合方案 ✅
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  ├── 布局：vw/vh
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  ├── 字体：clamp()
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  ├── 图表：JS 动态计算
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  └── 组件：Container Queries
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-19">常见 FAQ</h2>
<p><strong>Q：大屏一般用什么设计稿尺寸？</strong> A：1920×1080 最常见。如果是 4K 屏，设计稿按 3840×2160 出，但开发时可以按 1920×1080 写，浏览器会自动处理设备像素比。</p>
<p><strong>Q：scale 方案字体模糊怎么办？</strong> A：没有完美解决方案。可以尝试 <code>will-change: transform</code>、<code>-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased</code>、设置较大基础字号然后缩小（而不是小字号放大）。实在不行就换 vw/vh 方案。</p>
<p><strong>Q：ECharts 图表在 resize 后字体没变怎么办？</strong> A：<code>chart.resize()</code> 只更新画布尺寸，不会重新计算 option 中的固定 px 值。你需要在 resize 时重新调用 <code>setOption</code>，将 fontSize 等值用 JS 函数动态计算。</p>
<p><strong>Q：大屏需要适配移动端吗？</strong> A：一般不需要。大屏就是大屏，手机打开看的场景极少。如果甲方非要，建议做两套页面，用媒体查询切换，而不是一套代码适配所有。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-20">总结</h2>
<p>大屏适配没有银弹。scale 最简单但最受限，vw/vh 最灵活但开发成本高，rem 两头不靠。生产项目推荐混合方案，把每种技术用在它最擅长的地方。</p>
<p>最重要的是：<strong>开工前跟甲方确认好所有要投放的屏幕尺寸和比例。</strong> 很多适配问题不是技术问题，是需求沟通问题。</p></div></div>
